summary: FRONTEND-only E2E of appointment duplicate prevention on Preview using SYNTHETIC data only (directory patient 'ZZTEST2563, Uisynth' PIN 9256 + verified portal patient 'ZZTEST2563, Portalsynth' uisynth-2563@synthetic.test). All 4 requested flows PASS. (1) Staff Calendar: booked Oct 26 1:00 PM -> toast 'Appointment booked and patient notified.'; second booking same patient Oct 26 1:30 PM -> amber same-day-override-panel with same-day-existing 'APT-000230 · 2026 Oct - 26 13:00 · UI synth first'; same-day-override-confirm disabled for empty AND whitespace-only reason, enabled after reason; confirm -> toast 'Appointment booked with same-day override (audited).', dialog closes, 2 appts shown on Oct 26. Oct 27 booking succeeded with no panel. (2) Review tab (appt-tab-review 'Review (2)'): week-flag listed patient name, PIN 9256, week Oct 26–Nov 01, '3 appointments', dates/times/reasons; same-day-dupe listed patient with '2 appointments' and OVERRIDE badge on APT-000231 only. Cancel from Calendar (reason radio required — cancel-free-slot disabled until chosen): after cancelling Tuesday flag stayed with count 2; after cancelling the override appt -> 'Review (0)', week-flags-empty and same-day-dupes-empty shown. (3) Portal: Nov 2 1:00 PM booked ('Appointment confirmed.'); Nov 2 1:30 PM -> error toast 'You already have an appointment on this day. Only one appointment per day is allowed — please choose another day, or reschedule your existing appointment.', no override UI/text anywhere, still 1 active card; Nov 3 1:00 PM booked (2 cards). (4) Cleanup done: 5 appointment_requests, slots, day locks, review flags, notifications, users/patients/directory docs deleted; verified 0 leftovers. No real patients/appointments touched.

minor.issue: 500 KeyError 'patient_type' when a patients doc lacks patient_type (hit with my first synthetic seed). Real patients have it, so only a robustness issue — use p.get('patient_type'). Seed script fixed to include patient_type='ohip'.

Same-day block message is English-only; portal supports ES (EN/ES toggle) and formatErr shows server text verbatim. Consider returning code and translating client-side via i18n using detail.code=SAME_DAY_EXISTS.
Week-flag appointment items omit same_day_override, so OVERRIDE badge is not shown in the week-flag list (only in same-day-dupe list). Add 'same_day_override' to the items projection for consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: Code review: clicking 'change' (setPatient(null)) does not reset conflict/overrideReason state. If staff hits a same-day conflict, then changes to a different patient, the override panel (with stale 'existing' list of the previous patient) is shown instead of 'Confirm & Book', forcing an unnecessary audited override. Reset setConflict(null); setOverrideReason('') when patient changes. Not UI-verified.

issues: Existing appt time shown in 24h ('13:00') while dialog title and calendar use 12h ('1:30 PM') — use the same timeLabel formatter.
'change' patient link is low-contrast slate-400 and has no data-testid.
After a same-day 409, the blocked day remains selectable and still shows free times; consider marking days where the patient already has an active appointment (UX hint, not required).

action_items: Reset conflict + overrideReason in BookSlotDialog (and verify BookAppointmentModal) when the selected patient changes
Use p.get('patient_type') in /api/portal/overview (and portal_access paths) to avoid 500 on docs missing patient_type
Optional: i18n for SAME_DAY_EXISTS portal message; include same_day_override in week-flag items; 12h time format in SameDayOverride existing list
